title: Forge — Reliability
_comment: Reliability: error rate by category (docs/15 §2), sandbox provisioning failures, provider errors (docs/14 §6).

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo_id FROM forge.session_event ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Error rate by category (docs/15 §2)
panels._comment: The 7 categories drive triage (auth, not_found, invalid_input, budget_exhausted, transient, upstream_failure, internal). forge.error.category (docs/14 §1).

targets.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'error_category') AS category, count() AS c FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'error' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY category ORDER BY c DESC

SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'error_code') AS code, JSONExtractString(payload, 'error_category') AS category, count() AS c, any(JSONExtractString(payload, 'error_message_truncated')) AS sample FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'error' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY code, category ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Sandbox provisioning failures (SANDBOX_PROVISIONING_FAILED)
panels._comment: Image-pull / capacity failures (docs/15 §3). Spikes signal an image or CF Sandbox capacity issue.

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, count() AS c FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'error' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'error_code') = 'SANDBOX_PROVISIONING_FAILED' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Provider errors (PROVIDER_ERROR — AI Gateway upstream)
panels._comment: AI Gateway 5xx after retries (docs/15 §3). Sustained spikes → failover provider weighting.

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, count() AS c FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'error' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'error_code') = 'PROVIDER_ERROR' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
